summary: Learn healthcare data analytics and decision support with SQL, Tableau, HL7/FHIR, and KPI dashboards. Build practical reporting skills today.
lede: Healthcare data analytics and decision support uses clinical, operational, and administrative information to guide decisions. For healthcare analysts, operations managers, and quality improvement professionals, the training focuses on preparing reliable data and turning analysis into practical reports. You’ll explore SQL-based data checks, healthcare KPI and dashboard design, and methods such as cohort analysis, risk stratification, and operational trend analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with healthcare information and need to turn it into clearer, faster, and more defensible decisions. It suits both analytical roles and operational roles that depend on healthcare data analytics and decision support to manage performance, compliance, and resource allocation.
outcomes: Dashboard Design In Power BI Tableau
modules: Quality Improvement Analytics with Lean Six Sigma
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, a spreadsheet application, and either Tableau or Microsoft Power BI for dashboard exercises. Access to sample healthcare datasets will be provided during the course, and prior SQL or analytics exposure will help you move faster through the applied work.
